context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 verified all Creator Tenant Onboarding & Dashboard features: 1) POST /api/tenant/validate-bot - validates bot token format and with Telegram API, 2) POST /api/tenant/onboard - creates tenant, admin, settings, default plan (returns tenant_id and miniapp_url), 3) GET /api/tenant/dashboard/{tenant_id} - returns stats, plans, payments, settings, 4) PUT /api/tenant/settings/{tenant_id} - updates UPI, channel, welcome message (requires owner verification), 5) POST /api/tenant/plans/{tenant_id} - creates new plan, 6) DELETE /api/tenant/plans/{tenant_id}/{plan_id} - deletes plan, 7) GET /api/tenant/lookup/{bot_username} - finds tenant by bot username. details: POST /api/tenant/validate-bot validates token format
Calls Telegram API getMe for validation
Returns bot_id, bot_username, bot_name on success
Returns valid=false with error for invalid tokens
POST /api/tenant/onboard creates tenant, admin, settings, default plan
Returns tenant_id and miniapp_url on success
Validates required fields (name, bot_token, telegram_user_id, upi_id)
Returns 409 for duplicate bot_token
Returns 400 for invalid bot token (rejected by Telegram)
GET /api/tenant/dashboard/{tenant_id} returns comprehensive data
Includes tenant info, stats, plans, payments, live sessions, settings
Returns 404 for non-existent tenant
PUT /api/tenant/settings/{tenant_id} updates settings
Requires owner verification (telegram_user_id match)
Returns 403 for wrong owner
Returns 404 for non-existent tenant
POST /api/tenant/plans/{tenant_id} creates new plan
DELETE /api/tenant/plans/{tenant_id}/{plan_id} deletes plan
Returns 404 for non-existent tenant
GET /api/tenant/lookup/{bot_username} finds tenant by bot username
Returns found=false for non-existent bot
4-step wizard: Info → Bot Setup → Payments → Done
Step 1: Name and Telegram User ID (required)
Step 2: Bot token validation with Telegram API
Step 3: UPI ID (required) + optional Razorpay keys
Step 4: Success page with Mini App URL and tenant ID
All data-testid attributes present
Loads at /creator-dashboard?tenant={tenant_id}
Shows stats: Revenue, Active Subs, Total Users, Pending
Overview tab: Recent Payments and Live Sessions
Plans tab: Plan cards with CRUD operations
Settings tab: UPI, Channel, Welcome Message, Website, Razorpay
Copy Mini App URL button present
Error state for invalid tenant with link to create new bot
